subject: GCP private offer — temporary consumption cushion & SKU handback request (LumenAI)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumenai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <m.li@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary consumption cushion for GCP private offer

Hi Priyom,

Quick context: our onboarding has hit a larger-than-expected spike as two customers finished integration at once. Our current private-offer SKUs are on pace to burn through the committed balance faster than the monthly draw schedule.

Can Redwood provide a short-term consumption cushion (one-off top-up or temporary reallocation from future months) to cover ~125k equivalent tokens for the next 30 days while we smooth usage? We want to avoid any service interruptions or throttling while we adjust batching and KV caching on our side.

Attached is our week-by-week forecast and a proposed MOP schedule that shows how we'd replenish the draw over the next 3 months. If needed, Marco can jump on a call.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is the Aurora integration win we discussed.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of CloudOps, LumenAI
elena@lumenai.com

Attachments: lumenai_consumption_forecast.xlsx, mop_proposed_schedule.pdf

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa/Ben: can you review the attached forecast and confirm what we can commit to (amount + repayment cadence)?
- Elena: any constraints on DocuSign or PO timing if we proceed with a short-term credit?

I’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth.

— Priyom

Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary consumption cushion for GCP private offer — LumenAI (please advise)

Marissa/Ben — forwarding Lumen’s ask and their forecast. Key asks: 125k token-equivalent cushion for 30 days; plan to replenish over next 3 months.

Things we need to decide internally:
- Structure: one-time credit, early draw against future private-offer commits, or temporary SKU reallocation (handback scheduling).
- Accounting/Invoice: will finance require an amended invoice or apply credit on next invoice?
- Co-sell collateral: will GCP co-sell be impacted by handback timings (we’ll need to inform our partner rep if we shift SKUs between months).

Soojin — can you confirm whether a temporary reallocation triggers any marketplace constraints on SKU mapping?

If you want numbers: their attached forecast shows the spike concentrated Jul 20–Aug 10 and then normalizing; worst-case exposure is ~135k tokens if nothing changes.

I recommend a short-term credit tied to a signed MOP amendment and a repayment schedule in three monthly installments. That avoids doing an early draw that could skew our monthly metrics.

Appreciate quick turnaround — Elena is ready to sign.

— Priyom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@lumenai.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary consumption cushion for GCP private offer — LumenAI (proposal)

Thanks for the context — reviewed forecast and ops impact. Proposed approach below:

Proposal (recommended):
- Provide a one-off credit equivalent to 125k token units for the 30-day window (applied as an invoiced credit).
- Require a signed MOP amendment (we’ll send a two-page addendum) that:
  - Documents the credit amount and exact repayment schedule (three equal monthly replenishment draws starting on Sep 1).
  - Confirms LumenAI will provide weekly usage snapshots for the first 6 weeks so we can validate KV/batching improvements.
- No change to co-sell status; we will notify the GCP partner rep, but this is an internal draw scheduling change and should not affect marketplace listing.

Operational notes for Ben/Soojin:
- Ben: confirm whether legal wants any special language for the repayment clause or if invoice credit + MOP amendment is sufficient.
- Soojin: confirm there are no SKU mapping constraints for applying a credit vs. triggering an early draw. If SKU reallocation is required, we need to coordinate with the GCP partner rep (I can draft the note).

If all agree, I’ll prepare the MOP amendment and route for signature.

— Marissa Cole
Co-sell Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
